features.title: Online features
features.playHistoryHelp:
Keep what you played and when in your Zaparoo Online account. This feature is free.

The first sync uploads retained local play history. Turning it off stops future uploads.
features.playHistorySummary: Free. Keep what you played and when in your Zaparoo Online account.
features.automaticBackupHelp:
Protect supported settings, inputs, saves, and save states with scheduled off-device backups. Uploads require an active Warp subscription.

Turning this off stops automatic uploads. Existing cloud backups remain available to restore.

readers.title: Readers
readers.scanModeHelp:
**Tap:** Default mode. Media will launch on scan and token removals are not tracked.

**Hold:** Media will launch on scan and exit when the token is removed from the reader. Only works with external readers, not in-app scanning.
readers.continuousScanHelp: When enabled, the in-app reader on the Zap page will keep scanning for tokens even after reading one.
readers.launchOnScanHelp: When a token is scanned using the in-app reader, it will be forwarded to the connected device, making the app work as a wireless reader. This is a Pro feature.
readers.preferExternalReaderHelp: When enabled, writes will be forwarded to an external reader on the connected device instead of in this app.
readers.shakeToLaunchHelp: Shake your phone to launch random media or run custom ZapScript. This is a Pro feature.
readers.audioFeedbackHelp: When enabled, the connected device will play audio when a token scan has succeeded or failed.
readers.autoDetectReadersHelp: When enabled, the connected device will attempt to automatically detect and connect to any attached readers.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.errorReportingHelp: Enable anonymous error reporting to help identify and fix bugs faster. Reports are anonymized and sent via Sentry. No personal data is collected.
advanced.errorReportingConfirmText: Error reports help us fix bugs faster. Reports are anonymized and sent via Sentry. No personal data is collected.
advanced.debugLoggingHelp: Enables more verbose log files on the connected device. Can be useful for troubleshooting issues.
advanced.showFilenamesHelp: For in-app search results, display media's full filename in the list instead of the cleaned up version. Can be useful if you use a lot of custom tags in your filenames.
advanced.appIconBadgesHelp: Show the unread inbox count on the app icon. iOS may ask for notification permission because badges are managed through notification settings.

playtime.title: Playtime limits
playtime.enabledHelp:
Enforce limits on how long media can be played for on the connected device.

**Daily limit:** Total amount of time media can be played for the day across all sessions. Resets daily.

**Session limit:** Maximum amount of time media can be played at once.

**Session reset timeout:** Amount of time required after a session has completed before a new session can start.
playtime.neverReset: Never reset (0 = keeps session active until daily limit)

profiles.roleHelp: Admins can authorize profile management. Members cannot.
profiles.unlimitedHelp: Set both fields to 0 for unlimited playtime.

profiles.resetCardsConfirm: Reset cards for {{name}}? Existing profile cards will stop working.

welcome.title: Welcome to Zaparoo!
welcome.text: Let's get you set up. This tour will show you how to connect to your device, scan your library, and create your first token.

deviceAddress.title: Connect Your Device
deviceAddress.text: Tap the search icon to find Zaparoo devices on your network, or enter a device IP address manually if needed.

mediaDatabase.title: Update Media Library
mediaDatabase.text: After connecting, use this button to scan and index your media library. We use this for searching and launching.

createCards.title: Search for Media
createCards.text: Once that's done, use the search to find media from your library. When you find something, tap it to write it to a token.

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.text: That's it! Once you've made your first token, launch it from this screen or using a reader connected to your device.
